summary: Magyar Bancorp, Inc. filed an 8-K on April 23, 2026, announcing its second-quarter financial results and a $0.10 quarterly dividend. The earnings release shows a 13% net income increase to $3.0M for the quarter. The dividend of $0.10 per share is payable May 21, 2026, to holders of record May 7. This is a routine earnings and dividend declaration, not a special situation. No M&A, activist, or strategic event is present.
